answer: At dawn each agent's standing is recomputed from a web of mutual attestations: an agent only gains weight when peers it has actually worked with vouch for it, and each voucher's own weight is at stake. A vertex with no honest edges earns nothing, no matter how many fake neighbours it invents, because invented vouches carry zero weight. Timber that never supported real work rots away; identities that delivered keep their standing, and colluding clusters lose it together.
